review_description: Everything was fantastic from original quote to installation. The crew that installed were true gentlemen

The whole process from start to finish was handled very professionally. The guys at Southwest Solar Force went through several solar systems in detail with great knowledge of them all.The installation was done efficiently which was a surprise as the weather that day wasn’t ideal.The customer service was top shelf, they took care of absolutely everything which meant once the system was installed we could take advantage of it straight away.I highly recommend Southwest Solar Force.

The quote process was easy, Lorraine was able to give us a price and all the information we needed in person and she followed up with a formal quote via email the same day. I had 3 quotes done in the same day and South West Solar Force provided the best price and was also able to provided an extra 3 years on top of the standard 10 year warranty on the inverter.The guys doing the installation were punctual and polite and left the place clean. After the installation was complete I was shown how the system worked and how to set up and use the app as well as how to tell if the system isn't working correctly and what to do if that happens.
Really good.Good sales rep.Great installation crew.Free power
All aspects of transaction from start to finish were excellent.

review_description: Great process and follow up. Very pleased with service overall.
The team were very responsive, knowledgeable and professional. They looked at my needs did not try to over sell things I did not need.

I had two different companies to quote on my solar system. I had an idea of what I wanted and how much I should be paying for it because I had done lots of researches and read a lot about it (thanks to Finn Peacock).Southwest Solar understood my needs.  From the very first appointment the sales rep (Simon) was cordial, professional (not pushy) and easy to deal with. Installation was a breeze. Very happy with the results.

Quoting process was friendly and efficient. Everything explained and all my questions answered respectfully.Once I accepted the quote they took care of everything from arranging interest free finance to coordinating the meter upgrade with Western power.Install was booked within a reasonable time frame.On the day of Install the installers arrived on time, were polite and efficient, didn't cause any damage to my roof and then explained how everything worked and how to get help if something went wrong.

The sales person was prompt and factual coming to my premises the view the area and the talk over the processes.The quote was also prompt being emailed within 24 hours.The company kept me up to date with the installation date and any thing else i needed to attend to.On the day of installation the installers arrived on time. Both trades were polite and factual. The electrician discussed the position of my panels which i was very happy with as i felt we could do better than in the quote.The installation was without a hitch and a bonus all the rubbish was removed and the work area left clean and tidy.The grid connection was done entirely by Perth Solar Force and completed within 36 hours of the system install.

Quoting process was fine, I did have to ring office a few times to ask for an update that would be my only negative. But overall the sales & quoting process was great.Installation was great they were here when they said they would be and they installed way quicker than expected and all the team that did our install were super nice.After the install we had to get a wifi booster installed and that was done promptly about a week later. Since install we have needed a new consumption meter due to a faulty one, we are still waiting on this to be replaced, and well as Western Power they haven't done there section either.However our overall experience getting solar installed with South West Solar has been pretty positive.

I wish I had found solarquotes before signing up with this company, who approached me by door knocking. There have been a couple of minor issues - installation delay, wrong inverter installed, delay in letting me know my system was ok to turn on. However overall they have done a reasonable job. But probably would have gone with a different company suggested by solarquotes if I wasn’t already committed. They were good at giving me a better deal - better inverter and better price, but only when requested. All of the staff were polite, friendly and punctual.

They responded quickly, the rep was very informative without being pushy. The admin was fast and efficient and communication appeared super efficient between admin and installers . Everyone was polite and efficient . I will recommend this company at every opportunity.

Choosing the solar installer is not a simple one. The top two things I needed was 1) not feeling like I'm getting ripped off and 2) making sure I was dealing with a reputable company who was going to do a crappy install.It's now two months later and I'm happy to recommend South East Solar.

The quoting was very prompt by all 3 companies, Solar Force had the best price there installation was easy to arrange and team were great as the weather was not good.All the customer service was easy and they helped through the whole install

The entire process was smooth from sales to the signing of contracts through to installation. The waiting period from the signing of contracts to installation was reasonable considering the covid pandemic challenges. They kept me updated at every stage until the panels were installed. The installers were very punctual and finished quicker than expected. I will certainly recommend South West Solar Force.
Great service, prompt and professional installation with a friendly installation team

Came to our house to discuss our needs and wants, quote came through a couple of hours later. Just super fast and easy to deal with. Trades showed up on the day exactly on time and finished the install so quickly and efficiently. Would highly recommend. Great service.

South East Solar is highly recommended! From the initial quoting process, speaking to Anton was amazing. He answered all my questions about Solar and the process of it all. Was very informative and up front about providing all the information I needed. Arranging a suitable time frame and following up on when installers would arrive etc Taylah did a wonderful job with staying in constant contact. On the day of installation, Dan and Corey were punctual and did an amazing job setting everything up. They also did a few other electrical jobs on the day as well which was amazing. Overall I would recommended South East Solar to everyone!

Yuko from SWSF was very knowledgeable and professional.Answered all our questions and came up with a system that suited our needs.No pressure, and left us to think about it.  After getting other quotes we decided that their offer was the best value for money from a quality company.Communication after paying the deposit has been excellent, as we wait for approval and an install date.
sales person was the company owner, great knowledge.Install was difficult to arrange as a high roof, this took too long to arrange, however it was all good in the end.everything else was good.

Supplied all info requested, incident free installation.  Installers were polite, professional (answered any questions asked)and were on time and didn't waste any time doing the install and left no mess behind.When they left everything was up and running, and checked that the online facility was up and running on my phone too.
From initial enquiry to quote and install, the whole process was simple and easy.  Very professional and prompt, quality work.  Highly recommend

prompt contact by sales team. They were able to accommodate my requirements for a change of inverter and instal time due to our holidays .The installation team arrived at the stated time removed old panels and left the site clean and tidy very accommodating 5 star performamnce.When they left the system was up and running and has not missed a beat since. A totally satisfing experience from all. would recommend!!
